messages:
maria (infra): FYI seeing a surge in GPU node join failures in eu-west after we rolled the privnet-inspection certs this morning
aj (security): ugh, link to the alert/logs?
maria (infra): https://logs.internal/redwood/stream/rot-xyz TLS alert 40 -> handshake to keystore:443 failing from inspection proxies
jake (sre): staging had this earlier. nodes stall at `waiting-for-keystore` for 60s then fail
sam (platform): is the agent on node contacting keystore directly or via the proxy tier?
maria (infra): proxy tier does the fetch; if proxies don't trust the new intermediate CA they can't complete MTLS
ops-bot: diagnostic summary: affected proxy pods=38, failing gpu nodes=9, first-seen=2026-03-21T09:12:00Z
aj (security): we should avoid broad allowlist rules. proposal: narrowly scoped temporary egress exception for specific proxy CIDR
jake (sre): minimal blast-radius plan: add SG rule 10.200.42.0/24 -> keystore:443 for 30m, monitor node joins, then revoke
sam (platform): infra-config can apply the rule and a lambda to auto-revoke. I can open PR and run the job
aj (security): conditional approval: require terraform plan in ticket + approval comment here, and audit export to longterm-s3. TTL tag on the rule
maria (infra): filed INF-3124 with logs and plan, added `temp-rot-exception` tag
maria (infra): quick smoke test command: ```kubectl exec -n infra proxy-pod -- curl -v https://keystore.internal:443 --cacert /etc/certs/new-ca.pem```
sam (platform): ran that on a canary proxy: success with new CA bundle, fails without it
jake (sre): so we either update CA on all proxies (safer) or open the ephemeral rule to unblock joins immediately
aj (security): update rollout must be next step. Approving ephemeral rule for listed CIDR only (I approve in INF-3124)
sam (platform): PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra-config/pulls/678 includes lambda revoke at 45m and terraform plan output
ops-bot: terraform plan: +1 security-group-rule (eu-west) 10.200.42.0/24 -> keystore:443 awaiting apply
maria (infra): applying via infra-cfn-runner now
deploy-bot: apply started by maria (infra) run-id=apply-20260321-0950
jake (sre): watching node join metrics and logs
maria (infra): apply finished. rule created with tag=temp-rot-exception expires=2026-03-21T10:35:00Z
jake (sre): join failure rate dropped from ~5/min to ~0.6/min after rule applied
aj (security): confirm audit export: saw logs delivered to s3://audit-longterm/keystore/2026-03-21/ good
sam (platform): lambda scheduled to revoke at 10:35Z, will post when done
maria (infra): plan to run canary rotation after revoke to ensure proxies handle new CA
ops-bot: lambda revoke executed 2026-03-21T10:35:00Z rule removed
jake (sre): post-revoke canary: 10 node-join attempts, all succeeded, no TLS handshake errors observed
aj (security): followup action - add CA distribution health-check: alert if any inspection proxy misses current CA bundle or is >1 rotation behind
sam (platform): opened PLAT-889 to add health-check + automated CA propagation for proxies
maria (infra): closing INF-3124 with notes, links to PR, logs, and remediation steps. thanks all :thumbsup:
